notes.title: Demo Update! (8/13)
notes.content:
New Music ... more coming soon.

Rocks are now removable and can be placed wherever the player wishes.

Added animated clouds

Added Birds

Added a golden caboose (not reachable in demo)

Added many more props (most not reachable in demo)

Added auto collectors (only wood auto collector available in demo)

Reticle is no longer visible in spectator mode.

Track panel filter now hides when the panel is closed.

Fixed a bug where more resources were being deducted than should have been.

Fixed track id showing in error message instead of track name.

Made the stone icon look more like the stone 3D graphics.

Fixed some bugs with sidewalk auto-tiling



Known issues:

Auto-tiling of sidewalk tiles can auto-tile if the tiles are separated a little bit

* This is already fixed, but didn't make it into this release
